description: This file contains partial class definitions and method signatures related to AWS DynamoDB clustering options and helpers within the Orleans framework. It includes configuration classes, helper methods, and extension methods for integrating DynamoDB clustering into Orleans silos and clients.

classes.name: DynamoDBClientOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for DynamoDB client, including credentials and service info.

classes.name: DynamoDBGatewayListProviderHelper
classes.description: Helper class for DynamoDB gateway list provider, currently empty.

classes.name: DynamoDBMembershipHelper
classes.description: Helper class with static method to parse data connection strings for DynamoDB clustering.

classes.name: DynamoDBClusteringOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for DynamoDB clustering, extending DynamoDBClientOptions.

classes.name: DynamoDBClusteringSiloOptions
classes.description: Silo-specific options for DynamoDB clustering, including connection string.

classes.name: DynamoDBGatewayOptions
classes.description: Gateway options for DynamoDB clustering, extending DynamoDBClientOptions.

classes.name: AwsUtilsHostingExtensions
classes.description: Extension methods to add DynamoDB clustering support to Orleans client and silo builders.

methods.name: ParseDataConnectionString
methods.description: Parses a DynamoDB data connection string and applies settings to clustering options.

methods.name: UseDynamoDBClustering
methods.description: Extension methods to configure Orleans client or silo builders to use DynamoDB clustering with specified options.
